audio.text: Would you rather present first or last on Friday?

options: Yes, I'd rather present on Friday.
I gave her a present for her birthday last week.
Last, if that gives me more time to practice.

why.en: Either/or question → a choice with a reason. A answers "Yes" to a choice; B uses "present" as a noun (a gift).
why.tr: "Ya o ya bu" sorusu → gerekçeli seçim. A seçim sorusuna "Yes" diyor; B "present" kelimesini isim (hediye) anlamında kullanıyor.
why.es: Pregunta de "esto o aquello" → una elección con un motivo. A responde "Yes" a una elección; B usa "present" como sustantivo (regalo).
